newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgargas signs deal with, Ukraine firm.
newsitem.headline: Bulgargas signs deal with, Ukraine firm.

text.p: Bulgaria's state-owned Bulgargas has signed two long-term deals with foreign firms for Russian gas supplies, its executive director said on Thursday.
Vassil Filipov said under the contracts Bulgargas would receive natural gas at favourable prices.
One of the suppliers will be an Ukranian gas firm Ukragaz, which would supply natural gas at the price of $97 per 1,000 cubic metres, Filipov said.
Another supplier will be Germany's Wintershall AG, which is the energy subsidiary of BASF chemical group, he said, adding that Wintershall will supply 1,000 cubic metres at the price of $99.99.
Filipov said volumes of natural gas supplies had not been fixed yet.
Earlier this month he said that Topenergy, a Bulgarian-Russian joint gas stock company which is half-owned by Russia's Gazprom, had refused to lower its prices.
Bulgargas was getting Russian natural gas at the Bulgaria's border with Romania at the price of $107.6 per 1,000 cubic metres, he said.
